edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Xerath. Arcanopulse (Q) has monstrous range and his W (Eye of Destruction) both slows and amplifies follow-up, so he can chunk you and your ADC without ever entering your hook range. You can't answer his poke with a bare Dredge Line, so respect the zone: farm from behind the minion line, only step up when his Q is down, and never stand in his W circle where the slow guarantees the Q stun lands.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Xerath. Arcanopulse (Q) has monstrous range and his W (Eye of Destruction) both slows and amplifies follow-up, so he can chunk you and your ADC without ever entering your hook range. You can't answer his poke with a bare Dredge Line, so respect the zone: farm from behind the minion line, only step up when his Q is down, and never stand in his W circle where the slow guarantees the Shocking Orb (E) stun lands.
